note: American Samoa keeps its own borders (the United States' visa policy doesn't apply there): nationals of Canada, the Marshall Islands, Micronesia, Palau and the Visa Waiver Program countries apply online for a visitor permit (US$40, 3 business days ahead) for up to 30 days, Samoans for 10 days (taken as an ETA); everyone else needs a visitor permit applied for through a local sponsor, with a police clearance (taken as a visa). US nationals are home. Holders of a US visa or green card may also use the online permit (not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy (the Department of Legal Affairs' pages are archived only). Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Department of Legal Affairs' own visitor permit pages: the 30-day online permit for citizens of a US visa waiver country, the 10-day one for Samoan-born holders of a Samoan passport, and the sponsored permit, in person with a police clearance, for everyone else. The pages don't name Canada, the Marshall Islands, Micronesia or Palau, kept from Wikipedia's copy, nor the waiver countries themselves, which are the United States' programme's.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of American Samoa
sources.said: U.S. visa policy does not apply to the territory of American Samoa , as it has its own entry requirements and maintains control of its own borders. ... Holders of a valid U.S. visa or green card , nationals of Canada, Marshall Islands, Micronesia, Palau and countries in the U.S. Visa Waiver Program may apply online for a visitor permit for a stay of up to 30 days, at least 3 business days before travel ... Period of stay with entry permit waiver for nationals of Samoa increased from 7 to 10 days June 2025 ( 2025-06 ) : Entry permit waivers replaced with online visitor permits ... Other visitors need to obtain a visitor permit through a local sponsor, who must appear in person at the Immigration Office of the Department of Legal Affairs.

sources.title: American Samoa Department of Legal Affairs: Visitor Permit
sources.said: Samoa 10-DAY Samoa-born citizens, holding Samoa Passports, may apply and pay on-line here for a 10-day visitor permit. US Visa / Waiver 30-Day U.S. visa, visa-waiver, or green card travelers may apply and pay online here for a 30-day visitor permit. Other 30-Day Non-US visa waiver country travelers must be sponsored by an eligible local host, who must apply and pay in person at Immigration .
